title: Hub contract index (m3e-contract-index, version 1)
description: The hub's index of the modules' contracts: for each module (game-loop, data, asset-pipeline…) the namespace it owns in the ID registry, the version of the contract it publishes now, and where that contract file is. The hub writes it; M3E reads it, depends only on this format and never on where the file lives (docs/导出.md “中枢”), and compares the contracts a design was written to with it.

modules.description: By the module's id: game-loop, data, asset-pipeline, material-pro…

namespace.description: The namespace the module owns (the prefix of its ids and operations: game → game.pull). One module per namespace.

contractVersion.description: The version of the contract the module publishes now, as the module numbers it (1.4.0).

contract.description: Where the contract file is: a path relative to this index's folder (names joined by /, no ..), or an https:// address.

format.description: The contract file's format, when M3E reads one: m3e-game, asset-manifest, m3e-material…
